name: c64-debug-mcp

tools.name: get_monitor_state
tools.description: Returns whether the C64 is running or stopped, along with the current stop reason and program counter when available.

tools.name: get_session_state
tools.description: Returns emulator session state including transport/process status, auto-resume state, and the most recent hit checkpoint.

tools.name: get_registers
tools.description: Returns the current C64 register snapshot. Requires emulator to be stopped - call execute(action="pause") first if running.

tools.name: set_registers
tools.description: Sets one or more C64 registers by field name. Requires emulator to be stopped - call execute(action="pause") first if running.

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: Reads a memory chunk. Specify start_address and either data_length or end_address. Address can be decimal (53248) or hex string with prefix ($D000, 0xD000). Returns byte values as decimal numbers.

start_address.description: Start address: decimal (53248) or hex string with prefix ($D000, 0xD000)

data_length.description: Number of bytes to read (use either data_length or end_address)

end_address.description: End address (inclusive): decimal (53248) or hex string with prefix ($D000, 0xD000). Use either data_length or end_address.

tools.name: memory_write
tools.description: Writes raw byte values into C64 memory. Address and byte values support decimal, hex ($FF, 0xFF), and binary (%11111111, 0b11111111) formats. Requires emulator to be stopped.

address.description: Start address: decimal (53248) or hex string with prefix ($D000, 0xD000)

items.description: 8-bit byte value: decimal (255), hex with prefix ($FF, 0xFF), or binary with prefix (%11111111, 0b11111111)

data.description: Bytes to write: decimal (255), hex ($FF, 0xFF), or binary (%11111111, 0b11111111). Mixed formats allowed.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Controls execution with pause, resume, step, step_over, step_out, or reset. Pause and resume are idempotent (safe to call multiple times).

count.description: Instruction count for step and step_over actions

resetMode.description: Reset mode: soft (CPU reset), hard (full machine reset), or nuclear (complete VICE restart)

waitUntilRunningStable.description: When action is resume, wait until running becomes stable before returning

tools.name: wait_for_state
tools.description: Waits for the emulator to reach a target execution state and optionally remain there for a stability window.

executionState.description: Target execution state to wait for

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait before returning

stableMs.description: Optional stability window the target state must remain true before returning

tools.name: breakpoint_set
tools.description: Creates an execution breakpoint or read/write watchpoint. Specify start_address and either data_length or end_address. Address can be decimal (53248) or hex string with prefix ($D000, 0xD000).

start_address.description: Start address: decimal (53248) or hex string with prefix ($D000, 0xD000)

data_length.description: Size of the breakpoint range in bytes (use either data_length or end_address)

end_address.description: End address (inclusive): decimal (53248) or hex string with prefix ($D000, 0xD000). Use either data_length or end_address.

tools.name: breakpoint_clear
tools.description: Deletes a breakpoint by numeric id.

tools.name: program_load
tools.description: Loads a C64 program and optionally starts it.

autoStart.description: Whether the loaded program should be started immediately after loading

fileIndex.description: Autostart file index inside the image, when applicable

tools.name: capture_display
tools.description: Captures the current screen to a PNG file and returns the saved image path.

useVic.description: Whether to capture the VIC-II display when supported

tools.name: get_display_state
tools.description: Returns screen RAM, color RAM, the current graphics mode, screen memory addresses, and the current border and background colors.

tools.name: get_display_text
tools.description: Returns the current text screen as readable text when the C64 is in a text mode.

tools.name: write_text
tools.description: Types text into the C64. Automatically resumes if stopped and restores pause state after. Supports escaped characters and PETSCII brace tokens like {RETURN}, {CLR}, {HOME}, {PI}, and color names. Limit 64 bytes per request.

tools.name: keyboard_input
tools.description: Sends one to four keys or PETSCII tokens to the C64. Automatically resumes if stopped and restores pause state after. Use for key presses, releases, and taps.

action.description: Use tap for a single key event or press/release for repeated buffered input

keys.description: One to four literal keys or PETSCII token names such as RETURN, CLR, HOME, PI, LEFT, RED, or F1

tools.name: joystick_input
tools.description: Sends joystick input to C64 joystick port 1 or 2. Automatically resumes if stopped and restores pause state after.

durationMs.description: Tap duration in milliseconds (will be clamped to reasonable range)

instructions: This server is for C64 debugging. Use the tools directly to inspect, control, and interact with the C64.
